projectReset.kept: Kept: companies, collaborators, users, permissions, financial documents, payments, bank transactions and classifications.
projectReset.confirmDescription: This permanently deletes every project and its dependent records. Cannot be undone.

projectDelete.confirmDescription: Admin-only. The project can only be deleted if it has no linked records.
projectDelete.blocked: Project has linked records and cannot be deleted.
